item.title: NBR extends online VAT return submission deadline until Feb 22

item.title: Abdul Hasib made first VC of Dhaka Central Univ

item.title: Madrasha student stabbed dead in Jatrabari

item.title: Jamaat-led alliance to hold protest rally at 4:30PM

item.title: From fortress to fallout; Jatiya Party routed in Rangpur
item.description: In a dramatic political reversal, the Jatiya Party (JP-Ershad) failed to win a single seat in any of the 33 constituencies across Rangpur Division in the 13th national election, an unprecedented defeat in a region long seen as its electoral stronghold.The division, long associated with the party’s late chairman Hussain Muhammad Ershad, delivered a complete rejection of the JP, with several candidates even forfeiting their deposits.Political observers say the result signals a deep organisational

item.title: Nasimul Gani appointed as new cabinet secretary
item.description: Dr Nasimul Gani, Senior Secretary of the Ministry of Home Affairs, has been appointed as the Cabinet Secretary.The appointment was announced in a notification issued by the Ministry of Public Administration on Monday (16 February).Dr Gani has been appointed to the post on a contractual basis, according to the notification signed by Senior Assistant Secretary Mohammad Mamun Shibli.The order has been made effective immediately in the public interest.NSA

item.title: DSE revises trading hours for Ramadan
item.description: The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) on Monday has announced revised trading hours for the capital market during the holy month of Ramadan.In a notice issued at morning, the premier bourse said trading will take place from 10:00 AM to 1:40 PM throughout Ramadan.The post-closing session will be held from 1:40 PM to 1:50 PM.However, the DSE’s official office hours will run from 9:00 AM to 3:30 PM during the month.It said normal trading hours will resume after the end of Ramadan and the Eid-ul-Fitr holid

item.title: Tarique to visit Charmonai Pir's residence this evening
item.description: BNP Chairman Tarique Rahman visits the residence of Mufti Syed Muhammad Rezaul Karim, popularly known as Charmonai Pir, on Monday evening.BNP media cell member Shayrul Kabir Khan confirmed the matter to media.
